scope: Original PriVA resource lifecycle and refresh inventory; the Nextflow checkout shares these entries and additionally inventories its pinned workflow runtime.

definitions.maintained: Upstream feed or versioned distribution for which a refresh route should be retained; not a promise of constant maintenance or update frequency. Evidence/cadence uncertainty is recorded per resource.
definitions.snapshot: Selected artifact is fixed for this profile. Reuse a bundled copy if provided; external/licensed snapshots remain external and are not made redistributable.
definitions.derived: Built by PriVA from named dependencies; rebuilding preserves source scientific logic and records changed inputs.

defaults.automatic_updates: No new automatic update except the explicitly enabled ClinVar gene-stat age rule; existing external refresh behavior remains unchanged.
defaults.url_templates: Discovery/documentation, not proof arbitrary versions exist or are compatible. Consult current installer/pin manifests.
defaults.scientific_acceptance: Resource deployment and refresh do not establish public/family or changed-profile qualification.
defaults.credentials: No credentials, access tokens or signed URLs belong in this map.
defaults.install_vs_refresh: install_entrypoints records acquisition/reuse procedures; refresh.entrypoints records procedures to retain for maintained feeds/derived rebuilds. Fixed snapshots have no routine refresh function.
